name: Foundation: Galactic Frontier
description:
About This Game

Ignite engines, buckle up, and now dive into the epic sci-fi universe of Isaac Asimov’s Foundation—the beloved novels that also inspired the acclaimed Apple TV+ series!

As the Galactic Empire falls, new factions rise. The fate of humanity is in your hands. Command your starship, explore uncharted space, and dominate this sci-fi saga blending deep strategy with intense action!

Immersive Story: The Master Trader's Galactic Odyssey

  • Play a unique role as an interstellar trader/bounty hunter/political strategist navigating between the Empire, Foundation, other factions and rebels, uncovering the secrets of Seldon’s Plan and confronting with the mysterious enemy the Mule.

Mothership Simulation: A Sweet Space Home

  • Construct your spaceship! Build different cabins to offer everything you need to survive: food, water recyclers, and steel resource... With cannons armed on, it's time to pilot your mobile space haven into the blue sky!

  • Foster bonds with your crew, handle emergencies together and breathe life into ship. Every daily greeting adds a little more belonging to your adventures through space.

Star Crew: A Band of Vagabonds

  • Encounter heroes of various backgrounds and appearances in space and invite them onboard: a robot with encyclopedic knowledge but misses sarcasm, the legendary space cowboy, even the most wanted criminal.... Roam the cosmos together and write your legend among the stars!

Thrilling TPS Combat: Assemble Ultimate Squads

  • Engage in blistering firefights across exotic planets and derelict space ruins. Tear through hordes of enemies with 15+ heroes - mix tank-dps-healer trios to create your ultimate 3-hero strike team.

  • Screen-filling explosions drench every planetfall in pure adrenaline release—total vaporization victory.

Galaxy Wars: A Rising Trade Empire!

  • Master three combat craft classes—Kinetic, Ion, and Beam—and deploy them in optimal formations with different flagships, assigning the right commanders to unlock their full power. Strategize your fleets to exploit and protect your galaxy's trade routes from threats and rivals.

  • Join powerful alliances and showcase your RTS skills in large-scale interstellar conflicts. Rise as a dominant force in the galactic economy.

EMBARK NOW!
Write Your Sci-Fi Legend • Build your Ideal Flagship • Build Trade Networks • Forge Your Galactic Destiny!
short_desc: Command Asimov's OFFICIAL Foundation universe! Live the life as an interstellar trader to exploit your trade routes! Build your starship home, crush enemies in explosive shootouts & outsmart rivals with fleet strategies in epic space wars - with new content expanding your saga!
